svg.title: Accuracy vs. cost
svg.desc: Precision at 25 versus GPU cost in US cents per query on Sales, Contract, and Drug Safety. Each chart uses a logarithmic cost axis with its own labeled range. Retrieval denotes embedding retrieval. Pointwise ties for the most hits at the lowest cost on each task.
